loot_filter.rep_title: Changes of the filter "{0}" made in Awakened PoE Trade
loot_filter.rep_howto:
The game uses a copy of the filter with these changes. FilterBlade does not know about them:
its next sync overwrites the online filter with its own version.
To keep them in FilterBlade: open the filter there, find each tier below on the Customize page
(path after "In FilterBlade"), repeat the change and sync. Then the change can be removed in the app.
